description.narrative: General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2016Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: Due to implementation challenges and change of priorities by the AUC/PSD, the programme did not manage to acheive its initially stated objectives. It had experienced a slow start until the AUC and IA came to a common understanding of mutual goals and aspirations.However, it should also be noted that the necessary adjustments were made in view of the challeges and the programme has contributed to the efforts of ehancing the overall capacity of the AU liaisson offices and the various AUC departments, and the RECs. In this regard, the programme has contributed to improving the quality of reporting by the targeted AULOs in general through the provision of support on results based management. Moreover, even though most of the activities have focused on one country (contrary to the plan), the programme has contributed to popularization of the AU Charter on Democracy, Governance, and Election (ACDEG).
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
